
A [[loglang|loglang]] unrelated to [[Loglan|Loglan]] in which hex is the default base. [[Tinkit|Tinkit]] has used its existence to argue that Lojban is hex by default, which seems like broken logic to the rest of us.

*zo'ocai mi'e [[tinkit|tinkit]] .i ji'a ko tcidu tu'a la'o gy. [http://www.geocities.com/Athens/Agora/7070/liva.htm] .gy.
